name: Sefaria
summary: The Sefaria library of Jewish texts: Tanakh, Talmud, commentaries and more in Hebrew and translation, with links between texts, topics, lexicons, calendars and full-text search.
notes: Keyless. Texts are addressed by refs (Genesis 1:1, Berakhot 2a); spaces in a ref are URL-encoded in the path.
Each text version carries its own licence (e.g. CC-BY-SA, public domain); see the version's license field before reuse.
find-refs is asynchronous: it returns a task_id with HTTP 202, then poll GET /api/async/{task_id} until it holds the result.

endpoints.name: Get a text passage
endpoints.summary: The text of a ref in one or more versions (Hebrew source, translations), with version metadata and licences.

tref.description: A Sefaria ref: a human-readable citation such as Genesis 1:1, Berakhot 2a or Rashi on Genesis 1:1.

version.description: A language's full English name (english, hebrew, arabic; not case-sensitive), language|versionTitle for one exact version, or source, translation or primary. May be repeated. Default primary.

fill_in_missing_segments.description: 1 to fill gaps in a partial version from other versions.

return_format.description: text_only strips footnotes, inline refs and HTML; default keeps them.

endpoints.name: Get links for a ref
endpoints.summary: Known connections of a ref (commentary, midrash, quotations...) with their categories and optionally their text.

tref.description: A Sefaria ref: a human-readable citation such as Genesis 1:1, Berakhot 2a or Rashi on Genesis 1:1.

with_sheet_links.description: Include links to user source sheets; default 0.

category.description: Only links whose category exactly matches, e.g. Commentary.

categories.description: Only links in one of these categories, comma- or pipe-separated.

endpoints.name: Get everything related to a ref
endpoints.summary: Links, sheets, notes, media, manuscripts and topics for a ref in one call.

tref.description: A Sefaria ref: a human-readable citation such as Genesis 1:1, Berakhot 2a or Rashi on Genesis 1:1.

endpoints.name: Autocomplete a name
endpoints.summary: Refs, book titles, authors, topics and collections matching a string.

limit.description: Results to return; 0 means no limit.

endpoints.name: Search the library
endpoints.summary: Elasticsearch full-text search over library texts or user source sheets.

type.description: Index: text (library) or sheet (user source sheets); default text.

field.description: Field to query: exact or naive_lemmatizer for text; content for sheets. Default naive_lemmatizer.

slop.description: Maximum distance between query words; 0 is an exact phrase. Default 10.

filters.description: Filter values (no regex), matched to filter_fields by position; for text, path prefixes such as a category or book.

filter_fields.description: Fields the filters apply to; for sheets: collections, topics_en, topics_he.

aggs.description: Fields to aggregate on, e.g. path for text; group or topics for sheets.

sort_method.description: sort orders by sort_fields; score multiplies the sort field into the search score. Default score.

sort_fields.description: Fields to sort on, e.g. comp_date or pagesheetrank; exactly one when sort_method is score.

sort_score_missing.description: Value used when a document lacks the sort field.

source_proj.description: true to return the whole document, or field name(s) to project.

endpoints.name: Get the learning schedule for a date
endpoints.summary: Daily and weekly learning (Torah portion, Haftarah, Daf Yomi, ...) for today or a given date.

diaspora.description: 1 for the diaspora Torah reading, 0 for Israel.

year.description: Year; year, month and day must all be given, or today is used.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name; default the client's.

endpoints.name: Get a topic
endpoints.summary: A topic's metadata and, optionally, its links to other topics and the refs tagged with it.

with_links.description: 1 to include links to other topics.

annotate_links.description: 1 to add title and display fields to each link.

group_related.description: 1 to group related link types as the site sidebar does.

with_refs.description: 1 to include refs tagged with the topic.

endpoints.name: Look up a word in the lexicons
endpoints.summary: Entries from Sefaria's lexicons (dictionaries) matching a word or phrase.

word.description: Word or phrase to look up.

lookup_ref.description: A ref to refine the lookup.

never_split.description: Limit the lookup to the exact input string.

always_consonants.description: 1 to search with and without vowels.

endpoints.name: Get a book's index record
endpoints.summary: The full database record of a work's index: titles, categories and schema.

endpoints.name: Find citations in text
endpoints.summary: Starts an async job that identifies Sefaria refs cited in arbitrary text.

text.description: {body, title}; pass the text in body and '' as title for plain text.

example.body: Genesis 1:1 is a citation and also Mishnah Peah 3-4.

lang.description: he or en; default from the text's characters.

notes: A read over POST. Returns a task_id (HTTP 202); poll GET https://www.sefaria.org/api/async/{task_id} for the result.
